why: Incident: 'other driver's insurance details' stuck in missing facts and the claim never closed.
text:
Reference clock: 2026-10-15T15:00:00-07:00
Verified app account context (from the claimant's signed-in insurer app, treat as confirmed facts): policyholder name Jordan Lee, policy number AUTO-90210, vehicle 2013 Toyota Sienna
Role-labeled dialogue:
[1] Agent: Hello Jordan, are you and everyone else in a safe place?
[2] Claimant: Yes, all safe. A car hit my van from behind on Coleman Ave in San Jose this morning and sped off. Call me on the phone.
[3] Agent: Any photos? [4] Claimant: Not yet.
[5] Agent: Police report? [6] Claimant: No.
[7] Agent: Other driver details? [8] Claimant: No, they fled.
